name: Harbor Everything Hub — Lawful Source Registry
description: A categorized registry of public-domain, openly licensed, creator-published, publisher-authorized, and official metadata sources. This is a discovery/config registry, not a Harbor-native repository manifest.

source_policy: Openly licensed works, with license attribution and terms preserved
Creator-published works available through their official platform
Publisher-authorized previews and official library lending
excluded: Magnet links or torrent endpoints for unauthorized media
Direct-download mirrors for pirated books, comics, games, software, music, movies, or television
Scrapers that bypass DRM, paywalls, account restrictions, library loans, or anti-bot controls
policy.direct_download_policy: Only use a provider's official download mechanism where the provider explicitly makes the item downloadable under stated terms.
policy.rights_check: Verify item-level license and territorial rights before showing or downloading full content.

harbor_compatibility.manga_extensions: Harbor's native manga reader supports source plugins with popular/search/detail/chapters/pageUrls (and optional tags).
harbor_compatibility.ebook_extensions: Harbor's ebook reader supports ebook plugins with popular/search/detail/chapters/content, and may accept pageUrls for legacy providers.
harbor_compatibility.video: Use Harbor's regular Stremio Addons manager and Stremio addon protocol. This registry does not bundle video-stream endpoints.
harbor_compatibility.note: Entries marked link_only or metadata_only are not installable Harbor source plugins.

integrations.name: Project Gutenberg via Gutendex
integrations.rights: Check territorial copyright; Gutendex/Gutenberg catalogue includes public-domain works under US law.
integrations.notes: Prefer available EPUB or plain-text formats; retain Gutenberg attribution and terms.

integrations.name: Wikisource
integrations.rights: Check the license shown on each work/page.
integrations.notes: Use the MediaWiki API; do not scrape page HTML in bulk.

integrations.name: Open Library
integrations.rights: Respect lending limits, waitlists, DRM and account access.
integrations.notes: Follow Open Library rate limits; identify the application with a User-Agent and contact address; cache results; not intended as a bulk metadata backend.

integrations.name: Google Books
integrations.rights: Only show pages the publisher/Google authorize for the reader's region.
integrations.notes: Use country=MA for regional viewability checks. Never infer full-text access from a catalogue result.

integrations.name: Royal Road
integrations.rights: Authors retain rights; use platform-authorized access only.
integrations.notes: Do not access Premium-only chapters, drafts, or restricted endpoints. If automated access is not permitted by current terms, use the official website link.

integrations.name: Scribble Hub
integrations.rights: Creator-owned works; respect platform terms and author restrictions.
integrations.notes: No scraper endpoint is specified until an officially permitted integration is confirmed.

integrations.name: Wattpad
integrations.rights: Creator-owned works and platform licenses; do not bulk extract chapters.

integrations.name: Internet Archive — rights-filtered comics
integrations.rights: Filter and verify the license on each individual item; do not assume all Archive.org comics are public domain.
integrations.notes: BookReader/page-image availability and file formats vary by item.

integrations.name: Comic Book Plus
integrations.rights: Use only items explicitly identified as public domain and follow site terms.
integrations.notes: No API endpoint is asserted here.

integrations.name: Digital Comic Museum
integrations.rights: Use only items explicitly identified as public domain and follow site terms.
integrations.notes: No API endpoint is asserted here.

integrations.name: xkcd
integrations.rights: Follow the creator's license at https://xkcd.com/license.html; not all reuse is allowed.
integrations.notes: Official comic metadata and image URL; display attribution and license notice.

categories.label: Official manga, manhwa and creator-published comics

integrations.name: MANGA Plus by SHUEISHA
integrations.rights: Publisher-controlled access; respect regional restrictions and chapter windows.
integrations.notes: Do not scrape or mirror pages without an approved API or permission.

integrations.name: WEBTOON
integrations.rights: Respect creator and platform terms.

integrations.name: Tapas
integrations.rights: Respect creator and platform terms.

integrations.name: LibriVox
integrations.rights: LibriVox recordings are public domain in the US; check local rights for both text and recording.
integrations.notes: API supports title, author, genre, limit, offset, extended metadata and JSON format. Do not use Harbor's ebook text plugin interface for audio playback.

integrations.name: Internet Archive — open audio
integrations.rights: Verify the license of every item; archive hosting alone is not permission to reuse.

integrations.name: Openverse Audio
integrations.rights: Preserve creator attribution and comply with the individual CC/public-domain license.
integrations.notes: Openverse terms limit pagination and prohibit scraping its dataset.

integrations.name: Internet Archive — public-domain/open-license video
integrations.rights: Check item-level license and download restrictions.

integrations.name: TVmaze
integrations.rights: Metadata discovery only; TVmaze does not supply episode streams.

integrations.name: The Movie Database
integrations.rights: Metadata/images subject to TMDB terms; no video streams supplied.

integrations.name: AniList
integrations.rights: Discovery/tracking only; no video streams supplied.

integrations.name: Crunchyroll
integrations.rights: Use official viewing access.

integrations.name: HIDIVE
integrations.rights: Use official viewing access.

integrations.name: Steam App List
integrations.rights: Metadata only. Purchase, download, and ownership remain inside the official store.

integrations.name: IGDB
integrations.rights: Metadata only; follow IGDB attribution and API terms.

integrations.name: RAWG Video Games Database
integrations.rights: Metadata only; follow RAWG terms and attribution requirements.

integrations.name: Openverse
integrations.rights: Only use works with compatible licenses; preserve attribution and license links.
integrations.notes: Openverse API terms prohibit scraping its dataset.

integrations.name: Jamendo
integrations.rights: Check each track's license and permitted uses; Jamendo's licensing options vary.

integrations.name: Internet Archive — open audio
integrations.rights: Verify item-level rights.

integrations.name: User-supplied podcast RSS
integrations.rights: Respect publisher terms; private feeds may require credentials.
integrations.notes: No universal endpoint; users supply the feed URL.

integrations.name: Podcast Index
integrations.rights: Discovery metadata and publisher RSS links only.

integrations.name: F-Droid signed repository
integrations.rights: Use signed repository metadata and verify signatures; downloads should be handled by F-Droid.

integrations.name: WinGet Community Repository
integrations.rights: Install through WinGet and verify publisher/signature; do not download arbitrary installers from scraped mirrors.

integrations.name: Homebrew Formulae
integrations.rights: Install through Homebrew; formula metadata is not a direct executable download service.

integrations.name: arXiv
integrations.rights: Check the license of each paper; preprint availability does not always imply unrestricted reuse.

integrations.name: OpenStax
integrations.rights: Retain attribution and observe the license for each textbook.

integrations.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
integrations.rights: Course assets can have different licenses; verify the item-level terms.

integrations.name: Library of Congress
integrations.rights: Check rights-and-access notes for every item.

integrations.name: Internet Archive — periodicals
integrations.rights: Respect borrow-only, rights-restricted, and item-specific access conditions.

categories.label: Openly licensed images, audio and video

integrations.name: Openverse
integrations.rights: Display the license, creator, source page, and attribution requirements for each result.
integrations.notes: Not a bulk harvesting API; its terms prohibit scraping.

source_ranking.policy: No popularity ranking is fabricated. Where a source lacks comparable usage or quality data, preserve it as an unranked source.
